name: tequila/klass8s
description: Define Kubernetes manifests as PHP classes

scripts.tools:check: test -d tools/php-cs-fixer/vendor || { echo 'the dev tools are not installed — run: composer tools:install' >&2; exit 1; }

scripts-descriptions.build: Compile src/ and tests/ (.phn) into .src/ and .tests/, as every autoload dump does through the phaenon/phn plugin
scripts-descriptions.build:check: Build, then fail when the committed .src/ differs from what the build wrote (an output stale, missing or without a source), or when the archive Composer would install from leaves out a file the package needs or carries the tests
scripts-descriptions.check: Type-check the .phn sources and write nothing
scripts-descriptions.cs: Format the .phn: Phaenon's layout, then php-cs-fixer on the outputs with its changes carried back to the sources
scripts-descriptions.cs:check: Report what composer cs would change, then run build:check
scripts-descriptions.tools:check: Fail with what to run when php-cs-fixer is not installed (the pre-commit hook calls it first)
scripts-descriptions.tools:install: Install php-cs-fixer from its committed lock — runs after composer install and update, skipped under --no-dev
scripts-descriptions.tools:update: Update php-cs-fixer and rewrite its lock
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the suite on the compiled tests
scripts-descriptions.test:bundle: Run the bundle's part of the suite
